feeds.title: Mapping Megan Blog
feeds.description: We are Megan and Mike Jerrard. Professional travel bloggers and photographers with a focus on adventure, discovery, immersion and inspiring you to explore! Travel content from 100 + countries, and all 7 continents. Empowering you to seek adventure and incredible journeys.

feeds.title: Little Grey Box
feeds.description: Phoebe is a presenter, CNN & CNBC writer and award-winning blogger. Matt is a videographer, creative and photographer. Together, we run Little Grey Box; an award-winning travel blog and YouTube channel.

feeds.title: Mr and Mrs Romance
feeds.description: Lifestyle and travel blog by Jim and Christina Butcher who have been travelling together for over 15 years. You'll find advice and thoughts on all things food, travel, lifestyle, and living between these virtual pages.

feeds.title: The Aussie Flashpacker
feeds.description: I'm Simone. I started blogging as a way to keep my parents updated on my travels and life in the UK. The Aussie Flashpacker then developed into a place for Dan and me to share our travel tips, stories, and photos with other like-minded travel lovers.

feeds.title: Frequent Traveller Blog
feeds.description: Hi, we are Ros and Alan! In 2015 a series of life lessons taught us that time waits for no one, so we decided to change our life to one of full-time travel.Since then, we have visited 52 countries, lived in exotic locations, written for leading travel magazines, spoken at conferences about our lifestyle and have become one of Australia's most respected travel blogs.

feeds.title: Indefinite Leave Blog
feeds.description: Indefinite Leave is a site about the adventures of Kev and Adele as they travel around Australia in their motorhome. They have road tripped around Australia for many years and they blog about their adventures to inspire others to get out and do the same and see Australia first!

feeds.title: NOMADasaurus Blog
feeds.description: We're Alesha and Jarryd, the award-winning photographers, writers, and founders of NOMADasaurus. NOMADasaurus is the world's largest adventure travel and photography blog, featuring award-winning destination guides, photo tips and travel advice.

feeds.title: Love Your Travels
feeds.description: Love Your Travels is a business and blog by married couple Stacey & Wayne. Our page is to encourage others to get out there and see their own backyard with inspiring content and useful products to help you along the way.

feeds.title: Australia Your Way Blog
feeds.description: Hi, we are Paula and Charles. We have launched Australia Your Way to allow us to share our love of the rest of the country and to highlight the best experiences we have while we are exploring. From ancient cultures to offbeat characters, busy cities to stunning UNESCO sites, we are here to help you to discover your Australia.

feeds.title: Full Time Caravanning
feeds.description: Larry and Suzie, avid adventurers, embarked on full-time caravanning in November 2016, exploring Australia's remote corners and quaint towns. Their blog, http://www.fulltimecaravanning.com.au, chronicles their journey, sharing free and cheap campsites, invaluable tips, and memorable experiences. With a passion for exploration, they inspire others to discover Australia's beauty firsthand.

feeds.title: theworldwithchrisandsarah
feeds.description: Tales of our travels at home and abroad. Chris and Sarah began their travels together back in May of 2009. Chris was a novice, whilst Sarah veteran, having first set foot on foreign soil way back in 1994.

feeds.title: All Around Oz
feeds.description: All Around Oz, spearheaded by Melissa and Brenden, epitomizes a profound passion for travel and Australia's wonders. As avid adventurers, they champion exploration through their vibrant blog, igniting wanderlust and inspiring others to discover the magic of Australia. Renowned as Australia's premier community for caravanning, camping, and planning the ultimate lap around the country, All Around Oz stands as a beacon of adventure and camaraderie, beckoning travellers to embark on transformative journeys across the land Down Under.

feeds.title: 2 Aussie Travellers Blog
feeds.description: Follow 2 Aussie Travellers blog as we explore the sights, experiences and flavours of the world. Join us as we discover Australia, Japan, and beyond

feeds.title: Lydia and Wehan
feeds.description: Lydia and Wehan, collectively known as Foodie Couple Adventures, explore and venture into diverse realms like food blogging, photography, gaming, streaming, content creation, and influencer activities. Originally dedicated to showcasing culinary delights, their blog now showcases the journey of their relationship, including themes of love, travel, gaming, and of course, delectable meals.

feeds.title: Flying the Nest Blog
feeds.description: We are Stephen, Jess & Hunter Parry-Valentine, an Australian family with a passion for travel & adventure! Our story starts back in 2015 when the desire to drop everything to fly the nest overwhelmed us. Read about our travel adventures on this blog.

feeds.title: Explore Shaw Blog
feeds.description: We are Emma and Thom. We're travelling around Australia in our vintage Viscount caravan, exploring all the best destinations and experiences our beautiful country has to offer.

feeds.title: Lifejourney4two
feeds.description: Lifejourney4two follows the road-tripping adventures of Lars and Shelley, around the world. With firsthand experiences, they provide reliable tips, detailed itineraries, and insightful destination guides to ease your travel challenges. Find valuable tips and inspiration to travel.

feeds.title: Slightly Lost
feeds.description: An outdoor adventure and Australian travel blog by a couple of slightly lost wanderers. A couple with a relentless appetite for adventure, they have spent years traveling different corners of the globe before meeting for the first time in Brisbane, Australia.

feeds.title: StoryV Blog
feeds.description: We're Hannah, Dan and Eloí, an Australian/Brazilian family who live and travel around the world full time as digital nomads. StoryV Travel & Lifestyle is a travel blog featuring practical tips, strategies and stories to inspire and help you to live, travel & work around the world.

feeds.title: Tony and Kim Outdoor Adventures
feeds.description: Tony And Kim are travelers, adventurers, and bloggers from Brisbane. Tony and Kim + Shari Outdoor Adventures have something for everyone to enjoy including what adventures you can have in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia, and Overseas.
